sessionStart.powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path logs | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path logs/security.log -Value "{`"event`":`"sessionStart`",`"timestamp`":`"$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss')`",`"source`":`"copilot-agent`"}"
sessionStart.comment: Records a structured JSON entry in logs/security.log whenever a new agent session begins.

preToolUse.bash: mkdir -p logs && STDIN=$(cat) && TOOL=$(echo "$STDIN" | grep -o '"toolName":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/"toolName"://;s/"//g') && echo "{\"event\":\"preToolUse\",\"timestamp\":\"$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')\",\"toolName\":\"${TOOL:-unknown}\"}" >> logs/security.log
preToolUse.powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path logs | Out-Null; $stdin = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $tool = if ($stdin -match '"toolName":"([^"]+)"') { $Matches[1] } else { 'unknown' }; Add-Content -Path logs/security.log -Value "{`"event`":`"preToolUse`",`"timestamp`":`"$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss')`",`"toolName`":`"$tool`"}"
preToolUse.comment: Intercepts every tool call, extracts the toolName from stdin, and appends a structured JSON audit entry to logs/security.log. Returns no permissionDecision so all tools are allowed through by default.
